description: This Java interface named ResultList defines a generic list structure with additional pagination and sorting capabilities. It extends the standard List interface to include methods for obtaining the next page offset and the last result's sort values.

classes.name: ResultList
classes.description: A generic interface extending List with pagination (next page) and sorting info for search results.

methods.name: nextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for the next page of results, or -1 if there is no next page.

methods.name: lastResultSortValues
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonArray of sort expressions from the last result, if available.
